description: Avoids Windows desktop capabilities for ASP.NET Core hosting failures on IIS.
prompt: Redwood Gate returns HTTP 500.30 on IIS after deployment. Here's the ASP.NET startup exception and production config. What setting am I missing?

paraphrases.novice: Redwood Gate stopped responding after we put it on the Windows server. IIS says 500.30 and the log mentions a missing database setting. Can you fix the configuration?
